query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber:'38.331'}) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected <> '' WITH DISTINCT cr UNWIND split(cr.clausesAffected,',') AS raw WITH cr,trim(raw) AS clause WHERE clause <> '' MATCH (s:Section {sectionNumber:clause})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(:Spec {specNumber:'38.331'}) RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber,clause,s.sectionId
